179: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
180: {
181:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
182: }
183: 
184: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
185: {
186:   uint32_t reg;
187: 
188:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
189: 
190:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
191:   reg |= (1 << 1);
192:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
193: 
194:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
197:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
198:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
199: 
200:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
201: 
202:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
203:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
204:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
205:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
206: 
207:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
208: 
209:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
210:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
211:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
212:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
213:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
214:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
215: 
216:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
217: 
218:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
219: 
220:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
221: 
222:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
223: 
224:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
225: 
226:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
227: 
228:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
229: 
230:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
231:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
232:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
233: 
234:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
235: 
236:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
237:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
238: }
239: 
240: /****************************************************************************
241:  * UART0 引脚配置 (PA0=UART0_TX, PA1=UART0_RX)
242:  * 来源: D13x ic/pinmux/index.html + luban-lite target/d13x/demo88-nor/pinmux.c
243:  ****************************************************************************/
244: 
245: static void d13x_uart_pinmux_init(void)
246: {
247:   uint32_t val;
248: 
249:   /* PA.0 (UART0_TX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 0*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700080 */
250: 
251:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
252:                  0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
253:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
254:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
255:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
256:            0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
257: 
258:   /* PA.1 (UART0_RX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 1*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700084 */
259: 
260:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
261:                  1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
262:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
263:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
264:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
265:            1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
266: }
267: 
268: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
269: {
270:   uint32_t divisor;
271: 
272:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
273:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
274:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
275:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
276:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
277:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
278:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
279:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
280:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
281: }
282: 
283: /****************************************************************************
284:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
285:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
286:  ****************************************************************************/
287: 
288: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
289: {
290:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
291:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
292:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
293:   return val;
294: }
295: 
296: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
297: {
298:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
299:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
300: 
301:   switch (mark_id)
302:     {
303:       case 0x00: return 0;
304:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
305:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
306:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
307:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
308:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
309:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
310:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
311:     }
312: }
313: 
314: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
315:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
316:  */
317: 
318: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
319:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
320:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
321: {
322:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
323:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
324: }
325: 
326: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
327: {
328:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
329: }
330: 
331: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
332: {
333:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
334: }
335: 
336: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
337: {
338:   xspi_wait_idle();
339:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
340:   xspi_wait_idle();
341: }
342: 
343: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
344: 
345: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
346: {
347:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
349:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
350:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
351:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
352:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
353:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
354: 
355:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
356: 
357:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
358: 
359:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
360: 
361:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
362: 
363:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
364: 
365:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
366: }
367: 
368: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
369: {
370:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
371:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
372:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
373:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
374:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
375:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
376:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
377: 
378:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
379:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
380: 
381:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
382: }
383: 
384: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
385: {
386:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
387: 
388:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
389:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
390:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
391: }
392: 
393: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
394: {
395:   uint8_t mr4;
396: 
397:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
398: 
399:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
400: 
401:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
402: 
403:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
404: 
405:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
406: 
407:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
408: }
409: 
410: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
411: {
412:   uint32_t ctl;
413: 
414:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
415:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
416:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
417:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
418:    */
419: 
420:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
421: 
422:   xspi_wait_idle();
423:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
424:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
425:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
426: }
427:

I have now read all the relevant source files. Here is my complete review.

## Display Review Results

| # | Item | Status | Issue |
|---|------|--------|-------|
| 1 | Framebuffer memory allocation (`fbmem`) | **PASS** | `up_fbinitialize()` (artinchip_fb.c:188-194) allocates `D13X_FB_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT` bytes via `kmm_memalign(64, fb_size)`, provides 64-byte cache-line alignment, checks for NULL returning `-ENOMEM`, and zeroes the buffer with `memset`. The single-frame size (`D13X_FB_SIZE = 1024 * 4 * 600 = 2,457,600 bytes`) is stored separately in `fbi->fb_size`, and the total allocation is ~4.7 MB for double buffering. The corresponding `up_fbuninitialize()` (line 286) properly calls `kmm_free()`. |
| 2 | `fb_videoinfo_s.fmt` set to `FB_FMT_RGB32` | **PASS** | `d13x_fb_getvideoinfo()` (artinchip_fb.c:74) explicitly sets `vinfo->fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32`, matching the 32-bit RGB888 pixel format used throughout. The default zero value is not relied upon. |
| 3 | `fb_vtable_s` callbacks (open/close/getvideoinfo/getplaneinfo) | **PARTIAL** | `getvideoinfo`, `getplaneinfo`, `setpower`, `getpower`, and `pandisplay` are all wired up (lines 209-213). However, `open` and `close` are **not assigned**. While the vtable is `memset` to zero so these are NULL (NuttX treats NULL as a no-op), if any userspace client calls `ioctl(FBIOOPEN)` expecting a panel power-on or resource acquisition, nothing will happen. This is acceptable for a minimal driver but may cause issues with power-managed display workflows. |
| 4 | `up_fbinitialize` / `up_fbgetvplane` / `up_fbuninitialize` implemented | **PASS** | All three NuttX framebuffer framework entry points are implemented: `up_fbinitialize()` at line 170, `up_fbgetvplane()` at line 266, and `up_fbuninitialize()` at line 286. The bringup sequence in artinchip_bringup.c (line 126-127) correctly calls `up_fbinitialize(0)` then `fb_register(0, 0)` under `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`. |
| 5 | DE/DSI/LVDS initialization sequence | **WARN** | The sequence in `up_fbinitialize()` (lines 220-252) is: DSI init -> Panel init -> DE init -> set FB addr -> enable DE -> enable panel. The panel init (`d13x_panel_init()`) sends Sleep Out (0x11) with 120ms delay, then Display On (0x29). This means the panel is told to display **before** the DE is configured and the framebuffer address is set, so garbage/static may flash on screen momentarily. The canonical ArtInChip sequence (per luban-lite) is: clock/PLL -> DSI -> DE + framebuffer address -> enable DE -> panel sleep out -> panel display on. The panel display-on command should come **after** DE enable, not before. There is no LVDS initialization, which is correct since this board uses MIPI DSI. |
| 6 | Panel timing parameters match hardware | **PASS** | Panel timing constants in artinchip_panel.c (H=1024, V=600, HFP=160, HBP=160, HSYNC=40, VFP=10, VBP=20, VSYNC=8, pclk=51.2MHz) are mirrored exactly in the DE hardcoded values in artinchip_de.c (lines 127-129). Pixel clock sanity: (1024+160+160+40) * (600+10+20+8) * 60 = 1384 * 638 * 60 = 52.98 MHz, close to the 51.2 MHz nominal (yields ~59.2 Hz refresh, within typical tolerance). The DE does not call `d13x_panel_get_timing()` — timing is duplicated via hardcoded constants in both files. |

---

### Additional Findings (not in the original checklist)

**BUG -- `pandisplay` address calculation is incorrect** (artinchip_fb.c:145):
```c
fb_addr = (void *)((uint32_t)fbi->fb_mem + pinfo->yoffset * fbi->fb_size / (D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFER_COUNT));
```
Expanding the arithmetic: `yoffset * (1024*4*600) / (600*2)` = `yoffset * 2048`. But the stride is `1024 * 4 = 4096` bytes per line. The correct formula should be:
```c
fb_addr = (void *)((uint32_t)fbi->fb_mem + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE);
```
As written, `pandisplay` computes only **half** the correct byte offset, causing buffer corruption or display tearing when page flipping to the second buffer. For `yoffset = 600` (second buffer), the code computes offset = 1,228,800 bytes instead of the correct 2,457,600 bytes.

**WARN -- Duplicate `fb_register` / `board_app_initialize`** (artinchip_boot.c:68-71 and artinchip_appinit.c:28-30): Both files define `board_app_initialize()`. The boot version returns `OK` immediately with no display registration, while the appinit version also does nothing. The actual display registration happens via `board_late_initialize()` -> `artinchip_bringup()`. This is fine but the duplicate symbol definitions could cause linker issues if both are compiled.

**WARN -- DE timing hardcoded, not sourced from panel**: `d13x_de_init()` hardcodes the timing parameters rather than calling `d13x_panel_get_timing()` which is declared in artinchip_panel.h. If a different panel is used in the future, both files must be updated in lockstep.

You are a code reviewer for OpenVela (NuttX-based RTOS) on D13x board. Your task is to review code against documentation and report issues WITHOUT making any changes.

22: #endif
23: 
24: /****************************************************************************
25:  * Pre-processor Definitions
26:  ****************************************************************************/
27: 
28: /* 全局控制 */
29: 
30: #define G_BASE                  0x000
31: #define DE_CTRL                 (G_BASE + 0x000)
32: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE        (G_BASE + 0x008)
33: 
34: /* UI 图层控制 */
35: 
36: #define UI_BASE                 0x0a0
37: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL           (UI_BASE + 0x000)
38: #define UI_LAYER_SIZE           (UI_BASE + 0x004)
39: #define UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(n)   (UI_BASE + 0x020 + 0x10 * (n))
40: #define UI_RECT_OFFSET(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x024 + 0x10 * (n))
41: #define UI_RECT_STRIDE(n)       (UI_BASE + 0x028 + 0x10 * (n))
42: #define UI_RECT_ADDR(n)         (UI_BASE + 0x02c + 0x10 * (n))
43: 
44: /* 混合控制 */
45: 
46: #define BLENDING_BASE           0x100
47: #define BLENDING_BG_COLOR       (BLENDING_BASE + 0x000)
48: #define BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE    (BLENDING_BASE + 0x004)
49: 
50: /* 时序控制 */
51: 
52: #define TIMING_BASE             0x1d0
53: #define TIMING_CTRL             (TIMING_BASE + 0x000)
54: #define TIMING_INIT             (TIMING_BASE + 0x004)
55: #define TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE      (TIMING_BASE + 0x010)
56: #define TIMING_H_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x014)
57: #define TIMING_V_PORCH          (TIMING_BASE + 0x018)
58: #define TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE       (TIMING_BASE + 0x01c)
59: 
60: /* 控制位域 */
61: 
62: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN     BIT(0)
63: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN        BIT(0)
64: #define TIMING_CTRL_EN          BIT(0)
65:

67:  * Private Functions
68:  ****************************************************************************/
69: 
70: static inline void de_write(uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
71: {
72:   putreg32(value, D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
73: }
74: 
75: static inline uint32_t de_read(uint32_t offset)
76: {
77:   return getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
78: }

92: int d13x_de_init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
93: {
94:   iinfo("Initializing Display Engine: %dx%d\n", width, height);
95: 
96:   /* 配置更新使能 */
97: 
98:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
99: 
100:   /* 配置混合输出大小 */
101: 
102:   de_write(BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
103:   de_write(BLENDING_BG_COLOR, 0x000000);  /* 黑色背景 */
104: 
105:   /* 配置 UI 图层 0 */
106: 
107:   de_write(UI_LAYER_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
108: 
109:   /* 配置矩形区域 0 */
110: 
111:   de_write(UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE(0), (height << 16) | width);
112:   de_write(UI_RECT_OFFSET(0), 0);
113:   de_write(UI_RECT_STRIDE(0), width * 4);  /* RGB888: 4 bytes/pixel */
114: 
115:   /* 使能 UI 图层 */
116: 
117:   de_write(UI_LAYER_CTRL, UI_LAYER_CTRL_EN);
118: 
119:   /* 配置时序 */
120: 
121:   /* 主动区域 */
122: 
123:   de_write(TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE, (height << 16) | width);
124: 
125:   /* 前后肩 (简化配置) */
126: 
127:   de_write(TIMING_H_PORCH, (160 << 16) | 160);  /* HBP=160, HFP=160 */
128:   de_write(TIMING_V_PORCH, (20 << 16) | 10);    /* VBP=20, VFP=10 */
129:   de_write(TIMING_SYNC_PLUSE, (8 << 16) | 40);  /* VSW=8, HSW=40 */
130: 
131:   /* 使能时序 */
132: 
133:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, TIMING_CTRL_EN);
134: 
135:   /* 触发配置更新 */
136: 
137:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);
138: 
139:   iinfo("Display Engine initialized\n");
140:   return OK;
141: }

172: void d13x_de_enable(void)

175: 
176:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, TIMING_CTRL_EN);

178:   /* 触发配置更新 */
179: 
180:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, DE_CONFIG_UPDATE_EN);

182:   iinfo("Display Engine enabled\n");

332:    * LP 分频器 = sclk_rate / 8 / LP_RATE

338:   uint32_t div = sclk_rate / 8 / DSI_LP_RATE;
339:   uint32_t val = dsi_read(DSI_CLK_CFG);
340:   val &= ~(DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV_MASK);
341:   val |= DSI_CLK_CFG_LP_DIV(div);
342:   dsi_write(DSI_CLK_CFG, val);
343: 
344:   iinfo("DSI clock: pixel=%dHz, sclk=%dHz, div=%d\n",
345:         pixel_clock, sclk_rate, div);

347:   /* 配置包 */

351:   /* 配置 LP 传输时间 */
352: 
353:   dsi_write(DSI_DPI_LPTX_TIME, (64 << 16) | 64);

356: 
357:   dsi_write(DSI_TO_CNT_CFG, 0);

361:   val = BIT(24) | BIT(19) | BIT(18) | BIT(17) | BIT(16) |
362:         BIT(14) | BIT(13) | BIT(12) | BIT(11) | BIT(10) | BIT(9) | BIT(8);

**Item 9 -- Memory leaks in error paths (FAIL):**

The core problem is in `artinchip_fb.c` `up_fbinitialize()`:

1. **Panel init failure (line 232-236):** When `d13x_panel_init()` returns error, the function does not free `fb_mem` or reset `fbi->initialized`. The framebuffer memory is leaked and the driver is left in a half-initialized state.

333: /****************************************************************************
334:  * GT911 I2C 辅助函数
335:  ****************************************************************************/
336: 
337: static int gt911_i2c_write_reg(struct i2c_master_s *i2c, uint16_t reg,
338:                                const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len)
339: {
340:   uint8_t buf[2 + 64];  /* 寄存器地址(2字节) + 数据 */
341:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
342:   int ret;
343: 
344:   if (len > 64)
345:     {
346:       return -EINVAL;
347:     }
348: 
349:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(MSB first) + 数据 */
350: 
351:   buf[0] = (reg >> 8) & 0xff;
352:   buf[1] = reg & 0xff;
353:   memcpy(&buf[2], data, len);
354: 
355:   msg.frequency = 400000;
356:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
357:   msg.flags = 0;
358:   msg.buffer = buf;
359:   msg.length = len + 2;
360: 
361:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
362:   return (ret == 1) ? OK : -EIO;
363: }

365: /****************************************************************************
366:  * gt911_write_config - 写入GT911配置表
367:  *
368:  * 描述:
369:  *   向GT911写入配置参数（分辨率、触摸点数、中断模式等）
370:  *   来源: luban-lite gt911.c gt911_control()
371:  *
372:  ****************************************************************************/
373: 
374: static int gt911_write_config(struct i2c_master_s *i2c)
375: {
376:   uint8_t buf[2 + sizeof(gt911_config_table) + 1];
377:   uint8_t checksum = 0;
378:   int i;
379:   int ret;
380: 
381:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(0x8047) + 配置数据 + 校验和 */
382: 
383:   buf[0] = 0x80;  /* 配置寄存器地址高字节 */
384:   buf[1] = 0x47;  /* 配置寄存器地址低字节 */
385:   memcpy(&buf[2], gt911_config_table, sizeof(gt911_config_table));
386: 
387:   /* 计算校验和: 所有配置字节求和, 取反加1 */
388: 
389:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(gt911_config_table); i++)
390:     {
391:       checksum += gt911_config_table[i];
392:     }
393: 
394:   checksum = (~checksum) + 1;
395:   buf[2 + sizeof(gt911_config_table)] = checksum;
396: 
397:   /* 写入配置 */
398: 
399:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
400:   msg.frequency = 400000;
401:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
402:   msg.flags = 0;
403:   msg.buffer = buf;
404:   msg.length = sizeof(buf);
405: 
406:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
407:   if (ret != 1)
408:     {
409:       ierr("GT911 配置写入失败\n");
410:       return -EIO;
411:     }
412: 
413:   /* 写入配置更新标志 (寄存器0x8100 = 1) */
414: 
415:   uint8_t update_buf[3] = { 0x81, 0x00, 0x01 };
416:   msg.buffer = update_buf;
417:   msg.length = 3;
418:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
419:   if (ret != 1)
420:     {
421:       ierr("GT911 配置更新标志写入失败\n");
422:       return -EIO;
423:     }
424: 
425:   /* 等待配置生效 */
426: 
427:   up_mdelay(50);
428: 
429:   iinfo("GT911 配置写入完成\n");
430:   return OK;
431: }

451: 
452:   gt911_hw_reset();

454:   /* 获取 I2C 总线 */

457:   if (i2c == NULL)
458:     {

460:       return -ENODEV;
461:     }

466:   if (ret < 0)

469:       /* 继续注册驱动, 使用默认配置 */

144: /****************************************************************************
145:  * Name: gt9xx_i2c_read
146:  *
147:  * Description:
148:  *   Read a Touch Panel Register over I2C.
149:  *
150:  * Input Parameters:
151:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
152:  *   reg    - I2C Register to be read
153:  *   buf    - Receive Buffer
154:  *   buflen - Number of bytes to be read
155:  *
156:  * Returned Value:
157:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: static int gt9xx_i2c_read(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
162:                           uint16_t reg,
163:                           uint8_t *buf,
164:                           size_t buflen)
165: {
166:   int ret;
167: 
168:   /* Send the Register Address, MSB first */
169: 
170:   uint8_t regbuf[2] =
171:   {
172:     reg >> 8,   /* First Byte: MSB */
173:     reg & 0xff  /* Second Byte: LSB */
174:   };
175: 
176:   /* Compose the I2C Messages */
177: 
178:   struct i2c_msg_s msgv[2] =
179:   {
180:     {
181:       /* Send the I2C Register Address */
182: 
183:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
184:       .addr      = dev->addr,
185:       .flags     = 0,
186:       .buffer    = regbuf,
187:       .length    = sizeof(regbuf)
188:     },
189:     {
190:       /* Receive the I2C Register Values */
191: 
192:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
193:       .addr      = dev->addr,
194:       .flags     = I2C_M_READ,
195:       .buffer    = buf,
196:       .length    = buflen
197:     }
198:   };
199: 
200:   const int msgv_len = sizeof(msgv) / sizeof(msgv[0]);
201: 
202:   iinfo("reg=0x%x, buflen=%ld\n", reg, buflen);
203:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c && buf);
204: 
205:   /* Execute the I2C Transfer */
206: 
207:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(dev->i2c, msgv, msgv_len);
208:   if (ret < 0)
209:     {
210:       ierr("I2C Read failed: %d\n", ret);
211:       return ret;
212:     }
213: 
214: #ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO
215:   iinfodumpbuffer("gt9xx_i2c_read", buf, buflen);
216: #endif /* CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO */
217: 
218:   return OK;
219: }

221: /****************************************************************************
222:  * Name: gt9xx_i2c_write
223:  *
224:  * Description:
225:  *   Write to a Touch Panel Register over I2C.
226:  *
227:  * Input Parameters:
228:  *   dev - Touch Panel Device
229:  *   reg - I2C Register to be written
230:  *   val - Value to be written
231:  *
232:  * Returned Value:
233:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
234:  *
235:  ****************************************************************************/
236: 
237: static int gt9xx_i2c_write(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
238:                            uint16_t reg,
239:                            uint8_t val)
240: {
241:   int ret;
242: 
243:   /* Send the Register Address, MSB first */
244: 
245:   uint8_t regbuf[2] =
246:   {
247:     reg >> 8,   /* First Byte: MSB */
248:     reg & 0xff  /* Second Byte: LSB */
249:   };
250: 
251:   /* Send the Register Value */
252: 
253:   uint8_t buf[1] =
254:   {
255:     val  /* Value to be written */
256:   };
257: 
258:   /* Compose the I2C Messages */
259: 
260:   struct i2c_msg_s msgv[2] =
261:   {
262:     {
263:       /* Send the I2C Register Address */
264: 
265:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
266:       .addr      = dev->addr,
267:       .flags     = 0,
268:       .buffer    = regbuf,
269:       .length    = sizeof(regbuf)
270:     },
271:     {
272:       /* Send the I2C Register Value */
273: 
274:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
275:       .addr      = dev->addr,
276:       .flags     = I2C_M_NOSTART,
277:       .buffer    = buf,
278:       .length    = sizeof(buf)
279:     }
280:   };
281: 
282:   const int msgv_len = sizeof(msgv) / sizeof(msgv[0]);
283: 
284:   iinfo("reg=0x%x, val=%d\n", reg, val);
285:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c);
286: 
287:   /* Execute the I2C Transfer */
288: 
289:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(dev->i2c, msgv, msgv_len);
290:   if (ret < 0)
291:     {
292:       ierr("I2C Write failed: %d\n", ret);
293:       return ret;
294:     }
295: 
296:   return OK;
297: }

370: /****************************************************************************
371:  * Name: gt9xx_read_touch_data
372:  *
373:  * Description:
374:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
375:  *   Touch Points.
376:  *
377:  * Input Parameters:
378:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
379:  *   sample - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
380:  *
381:  * Returned Value:
382:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
383:  *
384:  ****************************************************************************/
385: 
386: static int gt9xx_read_touch_data(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
387:                                  FAR struct touch_sample_s *sample)
388: {
389:   uint8_t status[1];
390:   uint8_t status_code;
391:   uint8_t touched_points;
392:   uint8_t touch[7];  /* Track ID + X(2) + Y(2) + Area(2) */
393:   uint8_t track_id;
394:   uint16_t x;
395:   uint16_t y;
396:   uint8_t flags;
397:   int ret;
398: 
399:   /* Erase the Touch Sample and Touch Point */
400: 
401:   iinfo("\n");
402:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && sample);
403:   memset(sample, 0, sizeof(*sample));
404: 
405:   /* Read the Touch Panel Status */
406: 
407:   ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_READ_COOR_ADDR, status, sizeof(status));
408:   if (ret < 0)
409:     {
410:       ierr("Read Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
411:       return ret;
412:     }
413: 
414:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
415: 
416:   status_code = status[0] & 0x80;
417:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
418: 
419:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
420: 
421:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)
422:     {
423:       /* Read the First Touch Point (7 bytes: Track ID + coordinates)
424:        * GT911 register map: 0x814F = Track ID, 0x8150 = X_L, etc.
425:        */
426: 
427:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
428:       if (ret < 0)
429:         {
430:           ierr("Read Touch Point failed: %d\n", ret);
431:           return ret;
432:         }
433: 
434:       /* Decode the Track ID and Touch Coordinates */
435: 
436:       track_id = touch[0] & 0x0f;
437:       x = touch[1] + (touch[2] << 8);
438:       y = touch[3] + (touch[4] << 8);
439: 
440:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
441: 
442:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
443:       sample->npoints = 1;
444:       sample->point[0].id = track_id;
445:       sample->point[0].x = x;
446:       sample->point[0].y = y;
447:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
448:       iinfo("touch down id=%d x=%d y=%d\n", track_id, x, y);
449:     }
450: 
451:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
452: 
453:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
454:   if (ret < 0)
455:     {
456:       ierr("Set Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
457:       return ret;
458:     }
459: 
460:   return OK;
461: }

463: /****************************************************************************
464:  * Name: gt9xx_read
465:  *
466:  * Description:
467:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
468:  *   Touch Points.
469:  *
470:  * Input Parameters:
471:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
472:  *   buffer - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
473:  *   buflen - Size of buffer
474:  *
475:  * Returned Value:
476:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
477:  *
478:  ****************************************************************************/
479: 
480: static ssize_t gt9xx_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
481:                           size_t buflen)
482: {
483:   FAR struct inode *inode;
484:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
485:   struct touch_sample_s sample;
486:   const size_t outlen = sizeof(sample);
487:   irqstate_t flags;
488:   int ret;
489: 
490:   /* Returned Touch Sample will have 0 or 1 Touch Points */
491: 
492:   iinfo("buflen=%ld\n", buflen);
493:   if (buflen < outlen)
494:     {
495:       ierr("Buffer should be at least %ld bytes, got %ld bytes\n",
496:            outlen, buflen);
497:       return -EINVAL;
498:     }
499: 
500:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
501: 
502:   inode = filep->f_inode;
503:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
504:   priv = inode->i_private;
505: 
506:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent reads */
507: 
508:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
509:   if (ret < 0)
510:     {
511:       return ret;
512:     }
513: 
514:   ret = -EINVAL;
515: 
516:   /* If waiting for Touch Up, return the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
517: 
518:   if (priv->flags & TOUCH_DOWN)
519:     {
520:       /* Begin Critical Section */
521: 
522:       flags = enter_critical_section();
523: 
524:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
525: 
526:       priv->flags = TOUCH_UP | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
527: 
528:       /* End Critical Section */
529: 
530:       leave_critical_section(flags);
531: 
532:       /* Return the Last Touch Point, changed to Touch Up */
533: 
534:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
535:       sample.npoints = 1;
536:       sample.point[0].id = 0;
537:       sample.point[0].x = priv->x;
538:       sample.point[0].y = priv->y;
539:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;
540:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
541:       ret = OK;
542:       iinfo("touch up x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
543:     }
544:   else
545:     {
546:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */
547: 
548:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
549: 
550:       /* Skip duplicates */
551: 
552:       if (sample.npoints >= 1 &&
553:           priv->x == sample.point[0].x &&
554:           priv->y == sample.point[0].y)
555:         {
556:           memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
557:           sample.npoints = 0;
558:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
559:         }
560: 
561:       /* Return the Touch Point */
562: 
563:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
564: 
565:       /* Begin Critical Section */
566: 
567:       flags = enter_critical_section();
568: 
569:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
570: 
571:       priv->int_pending = false;
572: 
573:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
574: 
575:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
576:         {
577:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
578:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
579:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
580:         }
581: 
582:       /* End Critical Section */
583: 
584:       leave_critical_section(flags);
585:     }
586: 
587:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
588: 
589:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
590:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
591: }

593: /****************************************************************************
594:  * Name: gt9xx_open
595:  *
596:  * Description:
597:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
598:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
599:  *   Interrupts.
600:  *
601:  * Input Parameters:
602:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
603:  *
604:  * Returned Value:
605:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
606:  *
607:  ****************************************************************************/
608: 
609: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
610: {
611:   FAR struct inode *inode;
612:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
613:   unsigned int use_count;
614:   int ret;
615: 
616:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
617: 
618:   iinfo("\n");
619:   inode = filep->f_inode;
620:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
621:   priv = inode->i_private;
622: 
623:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
624: 
625:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
626:   if (ret < 0)
627:     {
628:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
629:       return ret;
630:     }
631: 
632:   /* Get next Reference Count */
633: 
634:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
635:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
636:   if (use_count == 1)
637:     {
638:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
639: 
640:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
641:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
642:       if (ret < 0)
643:         {
644:           goto out_lock;
645:         }
646: 
647:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
648: 
649:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
650: 
651:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
652: 
653:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
654:       if (ret < 0)
655:         {
656:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
657: 
658:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
659:           goto out_lock;
660:         }
661: 
662:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
663: 
664:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
665:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
666:     }
667: 
668:   /* Set the Reference Count */
669: 
670:   priv->cref = use_count;
671: 
672:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
673: 
674: out_lock:
675:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
676:   return ret;
677: }

679: /****************************************************************************
680:  * Name: gt9xx_close
681:  *
682:  * Description:
683:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
684:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
685:  *
686:  * Input Parameters:
687:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
688:  *
689:  * Returned Value:
690:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
691:  *
692:  ****************************************************************************/
693: 
694: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
695: {
696:   FAR struct inode *inode;
697:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
698:   int use_count;
699:   int ret;
700: 
701:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
702: 
703:   iinfo("\n");
704:   inode = filep->f_inode;
705:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
706:   priv = inode->i_private;
707: 
708:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
709: 
710:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
711:   if (ret < 0)
712:     {
713:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
714:       return ret;
715:     }
716: 
717:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
718: 
719:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
720:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
721:   if (use_count == 0)
722:     {
723:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
726:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
727: 
728:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
729: 
730:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
731:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
732:     }
733: 
734:   /* Set the Reference Count */
735: 
736:   priv->cref = use_count;
737: 
738:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
739: 
740:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
741:   return OK;
742: }

744: /****************************************************************************
745:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
746:  *
747:  * Description:
748:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
749:  *
750:  * Input Parameters:
751:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
752:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
753:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
754:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
755:  *
756:  * Returned Value:
757:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
758:  *
759:  ****************************************************************************/
760: 
761: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
762:                       bool setup)
763: {
764:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
765:   FAR struct inode *inode;
766:   bool pending;
767:   int ret = 0;
768:   int i;
769: 
770:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
771: 
772:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
773:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
774:   inode = filep->f_inode;
775:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
776:   priv = inode->i_private;
777: 
778:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
779: 
780:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
781:   if (ret < 0)
782:     {
783:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
784:       return ret;
785:     }
786: 
787:   if (setup)
788:     {
789:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
790: 
791:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
792:         {
793:           ret = -EDEADLK;
794:           goto out;
795:         }
796: 
797:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
798: 
799:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
800:         {
801:           /* Found an available slot */
802: 
803:           if (!priv->fds[i])
804:             {
805:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
806: 
807:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
808:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
809:               break;
810:             }
811:         }
812: 
813:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
814:         {
815:           /* No slots available */
816: 
817:           fds->priv = NULL;
818:           ret = -EBUSY;
819:         }
820:       else
821:         {
822:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
823: 
824:           pending = priv->int_pending;
825:           if (pending)
826:             {
827:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
828:             }
829:         }
830:     }
831:   else if (fds->priv)
832:     {
833:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
834: 
835:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
836:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
837: 
838:       *slot = NULL;
839:       fds->priv = NULL;
840:     }
841: 
842:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
843: 
844: out:
845:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
846:   return ret;
847: }
848: 
849: /****************************************************************************
850:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
851:  *
852:  * Description:
853:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
854:  *
855:  * Input Parameters:
856:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
857:  *   context - IRQ Context
858:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
859:  *
860:  * Returned Value:
861:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
862:  *
863:  ****************************************************************************/
864: 
865: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
866: {
867:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
868:   irqstate_t flags;
869: 
870:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
871: 
872:   /* Begin Critical Section */
873: 
874:   flags = enter_critical_section();
875: 
876:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
877: 
878:   priv->int_pending = true;
879: 
880:   /* End Critical Section */
881: 
882:   leave_critical_section(flags);
883: 
884:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
885: 
886:   poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLIN);
887:   return OK;
888: }
889: 
890: /****************************************************************************
891:  * Public Functions
892:  ****************************************************************************/
893: 
894: /****************************************************************************
895:  * Name: gt9xx_register
896:  *
897:  * Description:
898:  *   Register the driver for Goodix GT9XX Touch Panel.  Attach the
899:  *   Interrupt Handler for the Touch Panel and disable Touch Interrupts.
900:  *
901:  * Input Parameters:
902:  *   devpath      - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
903:  *   dev          - I2C Bus
904:  *   i2c_devaddr  - I2C Address of Touch Panel
905:  *   board_config - Callback for Board-Specific Operations
906:  *
907:  * Returned Value:
908:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
909:  *
910:  ****************************************************************************/
911: 
912: int gt9xx_register(FAR const char *devpath,
913:                    FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c_dev,
914:                    uint8_t i2c_devaddr,
915:                    const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config)
916: {
917:   struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
918:   int ret = 0;
919: 
920:   iinfo("devpath=%s, i2c_devaddr=%d\n", devpath, i2c_devaddr);
921:   DEBUGASSERT(devpath != NULL && i2c_dev != NULL && board_config != NULL);
922: 
923:   /* Allocate the Touch Panel Device Structure */
924: 
925:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct gt9xx_dev_s));
926:   if (!priv)
927:     {
928:       ierr("GT9XX Memory Allocation failed\n");
929:       return -ENOMEM;
930:     }
931: 
932:   /* Setup the Touch Panel Device Structure */
933: 
934:   priv->addr = i2c_devaddr;
935:   priv->i2c = i2c_dev;
936:   priv->board = board_config;
937:   nxmutex_init(&priv->devlock);
938: 
939:   /* Register the Touch Input Driver */
940: 
941:   ret = register_driver(devpath, &g_gt9xx_fileops, 0666, priv);
942:   if (ret < 0)
943:     {
944:       nxmutex_destroy(&priv->devlock);
945:       kmm_free(priv);
946:       ierr("GT9XX Registration failed: %d\n", ret);
947:       return ret;
948:     }
949: 
950:   /* Attach the Interrupt Handler */
951: 
952:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_attach);
953:   priv->board->irq_attach(priv->board, gt9xx_isr_handler, priv);
954: 
955:   /* Disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
956: 
957:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
958:   priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
959: 
960:   iinfo("GT9XX Touch Panel registered\n");
961:   return OK;
962: }

207:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
208: 
209:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
210:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
211:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
212:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
213:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
214:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
215: 
216:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
217: 
218:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
219: 
220:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
221: 
222:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
223: 
224:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
225: 
226:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
227: 
228:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 (MOD_RSTN bit13 + MOD_BUS_EN bit12 + MOD_CLK_EN bit8) */
229: 
230:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
231:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
232:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
233: 
234:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
235: 
236:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
237:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
238: }
239: 
240: /****************************************************************************
241:  * UART0 引脚配置 (PA0=UART0_TX, PA1=UART0_RX)
242:  * 来源: D13x ic/pinmux/index.html + luban-lite target/d13x/demo88-nor/pinmux.c
243:  ****************************************************************************/
244: 
245: static void d13x_uart_pinmux_init(void)
246: {
247:   uint32_t val;
248: 
249:   /* PA.0 (UART0_TX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 0*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700080 */
250: 
251:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
252:                  0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
253:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
254:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
255:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
256:            0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
257: 
258:   /* PA.1 (UART0_RX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 1*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700084 */
259: 
260:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
261:                  1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
262:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
263:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
264:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
265:            1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
266: }
267: 
268: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
269: {
270:   uint32_t divisor;
271: 
272:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
273:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
274:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
275:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
276:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
277:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
278:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
279:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
280:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
281: }
282: 
283: /****************************************************************************
284:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
285:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
286:  ****************************************************************************/
287: 
288: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
289: {
290:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
291:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
292:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
293:   return val;
294: }
295: 
296: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
297: {
298:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
299:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
300: 
301:   switch (mark_id)
302:     {
303:       case 0x00: return 0;
304:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
305:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
306:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
307:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
308:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
309:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
310:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
311:     }
312: }
313: 
314: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
315:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
316:  */
317: 
318: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
319:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
320:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
321: {
322:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
323:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
324: }
325: 
326: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
327: {
328:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
329: }
330: 
331: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
332: {
333:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
334: }
335: 
336: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
337: {
338:   xspi_wait_idle();
339:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
340:   xspi_wait_idle();
341: }
342: 
343: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
344: 
345: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
346: {
347:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
349:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
350:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
351:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
352:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
353:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
354: 
355:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
356: 
357:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
358: 
359:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
360: 
361:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
362: 
363:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
364: 
365:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
366: }
367: 
368: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
369: {
370:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
371:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
372:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
373:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
374:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
375:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
376:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
377: 
378:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
379:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
380: 
381:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
382: }
383: 
384: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
385: {
386:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
387: 
388:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
389:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
390:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
391: }
392: 
393: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
394: {
395:   uint8_t mr4;
396: 
397:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
398: 
399:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
400: 
401:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
402: 
403:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
404: 
405:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
406: 
407:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
408: }
409: 
410: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
411: {
412:   uint32_t ctl;
413: 
414:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
415:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
416:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
417:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
418:    */
419: 
420:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
421: 
422:   xspi_wait_idle();
423:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
424:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
425:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
426: }
427: 
428: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
429: {
430:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
431:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
432: 
433:   if (psram_size == 0)
434:     return 0;
435: 
436:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
437:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
438: 
439:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
440:     return 0;
441:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
442:     return 0;
443: 
444:   psram[0] = 0;
445:   psram[1] = 0;
446:   return psram_size;
447: }
448: 
449: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
450: {
451:   uint32_t reg;
452: 
453:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
454: 
455:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
456:     return;
457: 
458:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
459: 
460:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
461:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
462:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
463: 
464:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
465: 
466:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
467: 
468:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
469: 
470:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
471: 
472:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
473: 
474:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
475: 
476:   xspi_wait_idle();
477:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
478: 
479:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
480: 
481:   xspi_wait_idle();
482:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
483:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
484:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
485: 
486:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
487: 
488:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
489:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
490:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
491: 
492:   /* Boundary = 1K */
493: 
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
499: 
500:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
501:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
502:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
503:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
504:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
505:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
506:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
507:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
508: 
509:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
510: 
511:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
512: 
513:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
514:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
515:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
516: 
517:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
518: 
519:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
520:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
521:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
522: 
523:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
524: 
525:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
526:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
527:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
528:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
529:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
530:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
531: 
532:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
533: 
534:   xspi_wait_idle();
535:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
536:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
537:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
538: 
539:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
540: 
541:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
542: 
543:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
544: 
545:   d13x_psram_device_init();
546: 
547:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
548: 
549:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
550: 
551:   /* 8. 验证 */
552: 
553:   d13x_psram_verify();
554: }
555: 
556: /****************************************************************************
557:  * 看门狗处理
558:  ****************************************************************************/
559: 
560: static void d13x_watchdog_init(void)
561: {
562:   putreg32(0, WDOG_CTL);
563: }
564: 
565: /****************************************************************************
566:  * C 入口 (由 d13x_head.S 调用)
567:  ****************************************************************************/
568: 
569: void __start_c(void)
570: {
571:   /* BSS 清零和 .data 拷贝已由 d13x_head.S 完成 */
572: 
573:   d13x_watchdog_init();

146:  * GT911 复位时序 (来源: luban-lite gt911.c rt_hw_gt911_init)
147:  *
148:  * 1. RST=LOW, 等待 10ms
149:  * 2. INT=LOW
150:  * 3. 等待 2ms
151:  * 4. RST=HIGH
152:  * 5. 等待 5ms
153:  * 6. RST 切换为输入
154:  * 7. INT=LOW, 等待 50ms
155:  * 8. INT 切换为输入
156:  ****************************************************************************/
157: 
158: static void gt911_hw_reset(void)
159: {
160:   /* 1. RST=LOW */
161: 
162:   gpio_set_output(GT911_RST_PIN);
163:   gpio_write(GT911_RST_PIN, false);
164:   up_mdelay(10);
165: 
166:   /* 2-3. INT=LOW, 等待 2ms */
167: 
168:   gpio_set_output(GT911_INT_PIN);
169:   gpio_write(GT911_INT_PIN, false);
170:   up_mdelay(2);
171: 
172:   /* 4-5. RST=HIGH, 等待 5ms */
173: 
174:   gpio_write(GT911_RST_PIN, true);
175:   up_mdelay(5);
176: 
177:   /* 6. RST 切换为输入 */
178: 
179:   gpio_set_input(GT911_RST_PIN);
180: 
181:   /* 7-8. INT=LOW, 等待 50ms 后切换为输入 */
182: 
183:   gpio_write(GT911_INT_PIN, false);
184:   up_mdelay(50);
185:   gpio_set_input(GT911_INT_PIN);
186: }

188: /****************************************************************************
189:  * GT911 板级回调: IRQ 附加

195: /****************************************************************************
196:  * GT911 ISR 包装器: 清除 GPIO 中断状态后调用原始 ISR
197:  ****************************************************************************/
198: 
199: static int gt911_isr_wrapper(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
200: {
201:   uint32_t group = GPIO_GROUP(GT911_INT_PIN);
202:   uint32_t pin = GPIO_PIN(GT911_INT_PIN);
203: 
204:   /* 清除 PA2 GPIO 中断状态 (写1清除) */
205: 
206:   putreg32((1 << pin), D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT(group));
207: 
208:   /* 调用原始 gt9xx ISR */
209: 
210:   if (g_gt911_isr)
211:     {
212:       return g_gt911_isr(irq, context, g_gt911_arg);
213:     }
214: 
215:   return OK;
216: }

218: static int gt911_irq_attach(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state,
219:                             xcpt_t isr, FAR void *arg)
220: {
221:   uint32_t group = GPIO_GROUP(GT911_INT_PIN);
222:   uint32_t pin = GPIO_PIN(GT911_INT_PIN);
223:   uint32_t val;
224: 
225:   (void)state;
226: 
227:   /* 保存中断处理函数 */
228: 
229:   g_gt911_isr = isr;
230:   g_gt911_arg = arg;
231: 
232:   /* 配置 PA2 为 GPIO 通用功能 (PIN_FUN=1) */
233: 
234:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
235:   val &= ~(PIN_CFG_FUN_MASK << PIN_CFG_FUN_SHIFT);
236:   val |= (GPIO_FUN_GEN << PIN_CFG_FUN_SHIFT);
237:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
238: 
239:   /* 配置 PA2 为输入 */
240: 
241:   gpio_set_input(GT911_INT_PIN);
242: 
243:   /* 配置中断模式: 下降沿触发 (GT911 中断低电平有效) */
244: 
245:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
246:   val &= ~(0x7 << PIN_CFG_IRQ_MODE_SHIFT);
247:   val |= (GPIO_IRQ_FALLING << PIN_CFG_IRQ_MODE_SHIFT);
248:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_PIN_CFG(group, pin));
249: 
250:   /* 注册 GPIO 中断处理函数 (使用包装器以清除中断状态) */
251: 
252:   irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_GPIO, gt911_isr_wrapper, arg);
253: 
254:   return OK;
255: }

257: /****************************************************************************

259:  ****************************************************************************/

261: static void gt911_irq_enable(const struct gt9xx_board_s *state, bool enable)
262: {
263:   uint32_t group = GPIO_GROUP(GT911_INT_PIN);
264:   uint32_t pin = GPIO_PIN(GT911_INT_PIN);
265:   uint32_t val;
266: 
267:   (void)state;
268: 
269:   if (enable)
270:     {
271:       /* 清除中断状态 */
272: 
273:       putreg32((1 << pin), D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT(group));
274: 
275:       /* 使能 PA2 中断 */
276: 
277:       val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_TRQ_EN(group));
278:       val |= (1 << pin);
279:       putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_TRQ_EN(group));
280: 
281:       /* 使能 GPIO IRQ */
282: 
283:       up_enable_irq(D13X_IRQ_GPIO);
284:     }
285:   else
286:     {
287:       /* 禁用 PA2 中断 */
288: 
289:       val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_TRQ_EN(group));
290:       val &= ~(1 << pin);
291:       putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_TRQ_EN(group));
292:     }
293: }

356: /****************************************************************************
357:  * GT911 I2C 辅助函数
358:  ****************************************************************************/
359: 
360: static int gt911_i2c_write_reg(struct i2c_master_s *i2c, uint16_t reg,
361:                                const uint8_t *data, uint8_t len)
362: {
363:   uint8_t buf[2 + 64];  /* 寄存器地址(2字节) + 数据 */
364:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
365:   int ret;
366: 
367:   if (len > 64)
368:     {
369:       return -EINVAL;
370:     }
371: 
372:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(MSB first) + 数据 */
373: 
374:   buf[0] = (reg >> 8) & 0xff;
375:   buf[1] = reg & 0xff;
376:   memcpy(&buf[2], data, len);
377: 
378:   msg.frequency = 400000;
379:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
380:   msg.flags = 0;
381:   msg.buffer = buf;
382:   msg.length = len + 2;
383: 
384:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
385:   return (ret == 1) ? OK : -EIO;
386: }

388: /****************************************************************************
389:  * gt911_write_config - 写入GT911配置表
390:  *
391:  * 描述:
392:  *   向GT911写入配置参数（分辨率、触摸点数、中断模式等）
393:  *   来源: luban-lite gt911.c gt911_control()
394:  *
395:  ****************************************************************************/
396: 
397: static int gt911_write_config(struct i2c_master_s *i2c)
398: {
399:   /* GT911 配置寄存器: 0x8047-0x80FE (184字节), 0x80FF (校验和), 0x8100 (版本/更新) */
400: 
401:   #define GT911_CONFIG_SIZE    184   /* 0x8047-0x80FE */
402:   #define GT911_CHECKSUM_REG   0x80FF
403:   #define GT911_UPDATE_REG     0x8100
404: 
405:   uint8_t buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE + 2];  /* 寄存器地址 + 配置 + 校验和 + 更新标志 */
406:   uint8_t checksum = 0;
407:   int i;
408:   int ret;
409: 
410:   /* 构建写缓冲区: 寄存器地址(0x8047) + 配置数据 + 校验和 + 更新标志 */
411: 
412:   buf[0] = 0x80;  /* 配置寄存器地址高字节 */
413:   buf[1] = 0x47;  /* 配置寄存器地址低字节 */
414: 
415:   /* 复制前 184 字节配置数据 */
416: 
417:   memcpy(&buf[2], gt911_config_table, GT911_CONFIG_SIZE);
418: 
419:   /* 计算校验和: 配置数据字节求和, 取反加1 */
420: 
421:   for (i = 0; i < GT911_CONFIG_SIZE; i++)
422:     {
423:       checksum += gt911_config_table[i];
424:     }
425: 
426:   checksum = (~checksum) + 1;
427:   buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE] = checksum;      /* 0x80FF: 校验和 */
428:   buf[2 + GT911_CONFIG_SIZE + 1] = 0x01;      /* 0x8100: 写入标志 */
429: 
430:   /* 写入配置 */
431: 
432:   struct i2c_msg_s msg;
433:   msg.frequency = 400000;
434:   msg.addr = GT911_I2C_ADDR;
435:   msg.flags = 0;
436:   msg.buffer = buf;
437:   msg.length = sizeof(buf);
438: 
439:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
440:   if (ret != 1)
441:     {
442:       ierr("GT911 配置写入失败\n");
443:       return -EIO;
444:     }
445: 
446:   /* 写入配置更新标志 (寄存器0x8100 = 1) */
447: 
448:   uint8_t update_buf[3] = { 0x81, 0x00, 0x01 };
449:   msg.buffer = update_buf;
450:   msg.length = 3;
451:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(i2c, &msg, 1);
452:   if (ret != 1)
453:     {
454:       ierr("GT911 配置更新标志写入失败\n");
455:       return -EIO;
456:     }
457: 
458:   /* 等待配置生效 */
459: 
460:   up_mdelay(50);
461: 
462:   iinfo("GT911 配置写入完成\n");
463:   return OK;
464: }

472:  *
473:  * Description:
474:  *   初始化 GT911 触摸控制器
475:  *
476:  ****************************************************************************/
477: 
478: int d13x_touch_gt911_initialize(void)
479: {
480:   struct i2c_master_s *i2c;
481:   int ret;
482: 
483:   /* 硬件复位 GT911 */
484: 
485:   gt911_hw_reset();
486: 
487:   /* 获取 I2C 总线 */
488: 
489:   i2c = d13x_i2c_get_bus(GT911_I2C_BUS);
490:   if (i2c == NULL)
491:     {
492:       ierr("无法获取 I2C%d 总线\n", GT911_I2C_BUS);
493:       return -ENODEV;
494:     }
495: 
496:   /* 写入 GT911 配置 (分辨率、触摸点数、中断模式等) */
497: 
498:   ret = gt911_write_config(i2c);
499:   if (ret < 0)
500:     {
501:       ierr("GT911 配置写入失败: %d\n", ret);
502:       /* 继续注册驱动, 使用默认配置 */
503:     }
504: 
505:   /* 注册 GT911 驱动 */
506: 
507:   ret = gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", i2c, GT911_I2C_ADDR, &g_gt911_board);
508:   if (ret < 0)
509:     {
510:       ierr("GT911 注册失败: %d\n", ret);
511:       return ret;
512:     }
513: 
514:   iinfo("GT911 触摸控制器初始化完成\n");
515:   return OK;
516: }

144: /****************************************************************************
145:  * Name: gt9xx_i2c_read
146:  *
147:  * Description:
148:  *   Read a Touch Panel Register over I2C.
149:  *
150:  * Input Parameters:
151:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
152:  *   reg    - I2C Register to be read
153:  *   buf    - Receive Buffer
154:  *   buflen - Number of bytes to be read
155:  *
156:  * Returned Value:
157:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: static int gt9xx_i2c_read(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
162:                           uint16_t reg,
163:                           uint8_t *buf,
164:                           size_t buflen)
165: {
166:   int ret;
167: 
168:   /* Send the Register Address, MSB first */
169: 
170:   uint8_t regbuf[2] =
171:   {
172:     reg >> 8,   /* First Byte: MSB */
173:     reg & 0xff  /* Second Byte: LSB */
174:   };
175: 
176:   /* Compose the I2C Messages */
177: 
178:   struct i2c_msg_s msgv[2] =
179:   {
180:     {
181:       /* Send the I2C Register Address */
182: 
183:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
184:       .addr      = dev->addr,
185:       .flags     = 0,
186:       .buffer    = regbuf,
187:       .length    = sizeof(regbuf)
188:     },
189:     {
190:       /* Receive the I2C Register Values */
191: 
192:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
193:       .addr      = dev->addr,
194:       .flags     = I2C_M_READ,
195:       .buffer    = buf,
196:       .length    = buflen
197:     }
198:   };
199: 
200:   const int msgv_len = sizeof(msgv) / sizeof(msgv[0]);
201: 
202:   iinfo("reg=0x%x, buflen=%ld\n", reg, buflen);
203:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c && buf);
204: 
205:   /* Execute the I2C Transfer */
206: 
207:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(dev->i2c, msgv, msgv_len);
208:   if (ret < 0)
209:     {
210:       ierr("I2C Read failed: %d\n", ret);
211:       return ret;
212:     }
213: 
214: #ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO
215:   iinfodumpbuffer("gt9xx_i2c_read", buf, buflen);
216: #endif /* CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO */
217: 
218:   return OK;

221: /****************************************************************************
222:  * Name: gt9xx_i2c_write
223:  *
224:  * Description:
225:  *   Write to a Touch Panel Register over I2C.
226:  *
227:  * Input Parameters:
228:  *   dev - Touch Panel Device
229:  *   reg - I2C Register to be written
230:  *   val - Value to be written
231:  *
232:  * Returned Value:
233:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
234:  *
235:  ****************************************************************************/
236: 
237: static int gt9xx_i2c_write(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
238:                            uint16_t reg,
239:                            uint8_t val)
240: {
241:   int ret;
242: 
243:   /* Send the Register Address, MSB first */
244: 
245:   uint8_t regbuf[2] =
246:   {
247:     reg >> 8,   /* First Byte: MSB */
248:     reg & 0xff  /* Second Byte: LSB */
249:   };
250: 
251:   /* Send the Register Value */
252: 
253:   uint8_t buf[1] =
254:   {
255:     val  /* Value to be written */
256:   };
257: 
258:   /* Compose the I2C Messages */
259: 
260:   struct i2c_msg_s msgv[2] =
261:   {
262:     {
263:       /* Send the I2C Register Address */
264: 
265:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
266:       .addr      = dev->addr,
267:       .flags     = 0,
268:       .buffer    = regbuf,
269:       .length    = sizeof(regbuf)
270:     },
271:     {
272:       /* Send the I2C Register Value */
273: 
274:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
275:       .addr      = dev->addr,
276:       .flags     = I2C_M_NOSTART,
277:       .buffer    = buf,
278:       .length    = sizeof(buf)
279:     }
280:   };
281: 
282:   const int msgv_len = sizeof(msgv) / sizeof(msgv[0]);
283: 
284:   iinfo("reg=0x%x, val=%d\n", reg, val);
285:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c);
286: 
287:   /* Execute the I2C Transfer */
288: 
289:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(dev->i2c, msgv, msgv_len);
290:   if (ret < 0)
291:     {
292:       ierr("I2C Write failed: %d\n", ret);
293:       return ret;
294:     }
295: 
296:   return OK;
297: }

370: /****************************************************************************
371:  * Name: gt9xx_read_touch_data
372:  *
373:  * Description:
374:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
375:  *   Touch Points.
376:  *
377:  * Input Parameters:
378:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
379:  *   sample - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
380:  *
381:  * Returned Value:
382:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
383:  *
384:  ****************************************************************************/
385: 
386: static int gt9xx_read_touch_data(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
387:                                  FAR struct touch_sample_s *sample)
388: {
389:   uint8_t status[1];
390:   uint8_t status_code;
391:   uint8_t touched_points;
392:   uint8_t touch[7];  /* Track ID + X(2) + Y(2) + Area(2) */
393:   uint8_t track_id;
394:   uint16_t x;
395:   uint16_t y;
396:   uint8_t flags;
397:   int ret;
398: 
399:   /* Erase the Touch Sample and Touch Point */
400: 
401:   iinfo("\n");
402:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && sample);
403:   memset(sample, 0, sizeof(*sample));
404: 
405:   /* Read the Touch Panel Status */
406: 
407:   ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_READ_COOR_ADDR, status, sizeof(status));
408:   if (ret < 0)
409:     {
410:       ierr("Read Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
411:       return ret;
412:     }
413: 
414:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
415: 
416:   status_code = status[0] & 0x80;
417:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
418: 
419:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
420: 
421:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)
422:     {
423:       /* Read the First Touch Point (7 bytes: Track ID + coordinates)
424:        * GT911 register map: 0x814F = Track ID, 0x8150 = X_L, etc.
425:        */
426: 
427:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
428:       if (ret < 0)
429:         {
430:           ierr("Read Touch Point failed: %d\n", ret);
431:           return ret;
432:         }
433: 
434:       /* Decode the Track ID and Touch Coordinates */
435: 
436:       track_id = touch[0] & 0x0f;
437:       x = touch[1] + (touch[2] << 8);
438:       y = touch[3] + (touch[4] << 8);
439: 
440:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
441: 
442:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
443:       sample->npoints = 1;
444:       sample->point[0].id = track_id;
445:       sample->point[0].x = x;
446:       sample->point[0].y = y;
447:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
448:       iinfo("touch down id=%d x=%d y=%d\n", track_id, x, y);
449:     }
450: 
451:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
452: 
453:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
454:   if (ret < 0)
455:     {
456:       ierr("Set Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
457:       return ret;
458:     }
459: 
460:   return OK;
461: }

463: /****************************************************************************
464:  * Name: gt9xx_read
465:  *
466:  * Description:
467:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
468:  *   Touch Points.
469:  *
470:  * Input Parameters:
471:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
472:  *   buffer - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
473:  *   buflen - Size of buffer
474:  *
475:  * Returned Value:
476:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
477:  *
478:  ****************************************************************************/
479: 
480: static ssize_t gt9xx_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
481:                           size_t buflen)
482: {
483:   FAR struct inode *inode;
484:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
485:   struct touch_sample_s sample;
486:   const size_t outlen = sizeof(sample);
487:   irqstate_t flags;
488:   int ret;
489: 
490:   /* Returned Touch Sample will have 0 or 1 Touch Points */
491: 
492:   iinfo("buflen=%ld\n", buflen);
493:   if (buflen < outlen)
494:     {
495:       ierr("Buffer should be at least %ld bytes, got %ld bytes\n",
496:            outlen, buflen);
497:       return -EINVAL;
498:     }
499: 
500:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
501: 
502:   inode = filep->f_inode;
503:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
504:   priv = inode->i_private;
505: 
506:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent reads */
507: 
508:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
509:   if (ret < 0)
510:     {
511:       return ret;
512:     }
513: 
514:   ret = -EINVAL;
515: 
516:   /* If waiting for Touch Up, return the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
517: 
518:   if (priv->flags & TOUCH_DOWN)
519:     {
520:       /* Begin Critical Section */
521: 
522:       flags = enter_critical_section();
523: 
524:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
525: 
526:       priv->flags = TOUCH_UP | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
527: 
528:       /* End Critical Section */
529: 
530:       leave_critical_section(flags);
531: 
532:       /* Return the Last Touch Point, changed to Touch Up */
533: 
534:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
535:       sample.npoints = 1;
536:       sample.point[0].id = 0;
537:       sample.point[0].x = priv->x;
538:       sample.point[0].y = priv->y;
539:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;
540:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
541:       ret = OK;
542:       iinfo("touch up x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
543:     }
544:   else
545:     {
546:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */
547: 
548:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
549: 
550:       /* Skip duplicates */
551: 
552:       if (sample.npoints >= 1 &&
553:           priv->x == sample.point[0].x &&
554:           priv->y == sample.point[0].y)
555:         {
556:           memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
557:           sample.npoints = 0;
558:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
559:         }
560: 
561:       /* Return the Touch Point */
562: 
563:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
564: 
565:       /* Begin Critical Section */
566: 
567:       flags = enter_critical_section();
568: 
569:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
570: 
571:       priv->int_pending = false;
572: 
573:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
574: 
575:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
576:         {
577:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
578:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
579:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
580:         }
581: 
582:       /* End Critical Section */
583: 
584:       leave_critical_section(flags);
585:     }
586: 
587:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
588: 
589:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
590:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
591: }

593: /****************************************************************************
594:  * Name: gt9xx_open
595:  *
596:  * Description:
597:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
598:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
599:  *   Interrupts.
600:  *
601:  * Input Parameters:
602:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
603:  *
604:  * Returned Value:
605:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
606:  *
607:  ****************************************************************************/
608: 
609: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
610: {
611:   FAR struct inode *inode;
612:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
613:   unsigned int use_count;
614:   int ret;
615: 
616:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
617: 
618:   iinfo("\n");
619:   inode = filep->f_inode;
620:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
621:   priv = inode->i_private;
622: 
623:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
624: 
625:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
626:   if (ret < 0)
627:     {
628:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
629:       return ret;
630:     }
631: 
632:   /* Get next Reference Count */
633: 
634:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
635:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
636:   if (use_count == 1)
637:     {
638:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
639: 
640:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
641:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
642:       if (ret < 0)
643:         {
644:           goto out_lock;
645:         }
646: 
647:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
648: 
649:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
650: 
651:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
652: 
653:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
654:       if (ret < 0)
655:         {
656:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
657: 
658:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
659:           goto out_lock;
660:         }
661: 
662:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
663: 
664:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
665:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
666:     }
667: 
668:   /* Set the Reference Count */
669: 
670:   priv->cref = use_count;
671: 
672:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
673: 
674: out_lock:
675:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
676:   return ret;
677: }
678: 
679: /****************************************************************************
680:  * Name: gt9xx_close
681:  *
682:  * Description:
683:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
684:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
685:  *
686:  * Input Parameters:
687:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
688:  *
689:  * Returned Value:
690:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
691:  *
692:  ****************************************************************************/
693: 
694: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
695: {
696:   FAR struct inode *inode;
697:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
698:   int use_count;
699:   int ret;
700: 
701:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
702: 
703:   iinfo("\n");
704:   inode = filep->f_inode;
705:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
706:   priv = inode->i_private;
707: 
708:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
709: 
710:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
711:   if (ret < 0)
712:     {
713:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
714:       return ret;
715:     }
716: 
717:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
718: 
719:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
720:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
721:   if (use_count == 0)
722:     {
723:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
726:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
727: 
728:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
729: 
730:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
731:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
732:     }
733: 
734:   /* Set the Reference Count */
735: 
736:   priv->cref = use_count;
737: 
738:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
739: 
740:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
741:   return OK;
742: }
