744: /****************************************************************************
745:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
746:  *
747:  * Description:
748:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
749:  *
750:  * Input Parameters:
751:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
752:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
753:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
754:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
755:  *
756:  * Returned Value:
757:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
758:  *
759:  ****************************************************************************/
760: 
761: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
762:                       bool setup)
763: {
764:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
765:   FAR struct inode *inode;
766:   bool pending;
767:   int ret = 0;
768:   int i;
769: 
770:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
771: 
772:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
773:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
774:   inode = filep->f_inode;
775:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
776:   priv = inode->i_private;
777: 
778:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
779: 
780:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
781:   if (ret < 0)
782:     {
783:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
784:       return ret;
785:     }
786: 
787:   if (setup)
788:     {
789:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
790: 
791:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
792:         {
793:           ret = -EDEADLK;
794:           goto out;
795:         }
796: 
797:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
798: 
799:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
800:         {
801:           /* Found an available slot */
802: 
803:           if (!priv->fds[i])
804:             {
805:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
806: 
807:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
808:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
809:               break;
810:             }
811:         }
812: 
813:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
814:         {
815:           /* No slots available */
816: 
817:           fds->priv = NULL;
818:           ret = -EBUSY;
819:         }
820:       else
821:         {
822:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
823: 
824:           pending = priv->int_pending;
825:           if (pending)
826:             {
827:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
828:             }
829:         }
830:     }
831:   else if (fds->priv)
832:     {
833:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
834: 
835:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
836:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
837: 
838:       *slot = NULL;
839:       fds->priv = NULL;
840:     }
841: 
842:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
843: 
844: out:
845:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
846:   return ret;
847: }

849: /****************************************************************************
850:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
851:  *
852:  * Description:
853:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
854:  *
855:  * Input Parameters:
856:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
857:  *   context - IRQ Context
858:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
859:  *
860:  * Returned Value:
861:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
862:  *
863:  ****************************************************************************/
864: 
865: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
866: {
867:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
868:   irqstate_t flags;
869: 
870:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
871: 
872:   /* Begin Critical Section */
873: 
874:   flags = enter_critical_section();
875: 
876:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
877: 
878:   priv->int_pending = true;
879: 
880:   /* End Critical Section */
881: 
882:   leave_critical_section(flags);
883: 
884:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
885: 
886:   poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLIN);
887:   return OK;
888: }

894: /****************************************************************************
895:  * Name: gt9xx_register
896:  *
897:  * Description:
898:  *   Register the driver for Goodix GT9XX Touch Panel.  Attach the
899:  *   Interrupt Handler for the Touch Panel and disable Touch Interrupts.
900:  *
901:  * Input Parameters:
902:  *   devpath      - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
903:  *   dev          - I2C Bus
904:  *   i2c_devaddr  - I2C Address of Touch Panel
905:  *   board_config - Callback for Board-Specific Operations
906:  *
907:  * Returned Value:
908:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
909:  *
910:  ****************************************************************************/
911: 
912: int gt9xx_register(FAR const char *devpath,
913:                    FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c_dev,
914:                    uint8_t i2c_devaddr,
915:                    const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config)
916: {
917:   struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
918:   int ret = 0;
919: 
920:   iinfo("devpath=%s, i2c_devaddr=%d\n", devpath, i2c_devaddr);
921:   DEBUGASSERT(devpath != NULL && i2c_dev != NULL && board_config != NULL);
922: 
923:   /* Allocate the Touch Panel Device Structure */
924: 
925:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct gt9xx_dev_s));
926:   if (!priv)
927:     {
928:       ierr("GT9XX Memory Allocation failed\n");
929:       return -ENOMEM;
930:     }
931: 
932:   /* Setup the Touch Panel Device Structure */
933: 
934:   priv->addr = i2c_devaddr;
935:   priv->i2c = i2c_dev;
936:   priv->board = board_config;
937:   nxmutex_init(&priv->devlock);
938: 
939:   /* Register the Touch Input Driver */
940: 
941:   ret = register_driver(devpath, &g_gt9xx_fileops, 0666, priv);
942:   if (ret < 0)
943:     {
944:       nxmutex_destroy(&priv->devlock);
945:       kmm_free(priv);

## Verification Report: GT911 Touch Driver Fixes

**Files reviewed:**
- `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/openvela/vendor/artinchip/boards/d13x-hengshan-pi/src/artinchip_touch.c` (516 lines)
- `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/openvela/nuttx/drivers/input/gt9xx.c` (962 lines)

---

### 1. GT911 I2C address 0x5D

**PASS** -- Line 29 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
```c
#define GT911_I2C_ADDR          0x5D
```

### 2. RST=PA0, INT=PA2

**PASS** -- Lines 37-41 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
```c
#define GT911_RST_PIN           0   /* PA.0 */
#define GT911_INT_PIN           2   /* PA.2 */
```
The `GPIO_GROUP` macro (line 81) extracts `(pin >> 4)`, and `GPIO_PIN` (line 82) extracts `(pin & 0x0F)`. For pin=0: group=0 (PA), bit=0. For pin=2: group=0 (PA), bit=2. Correct.

### 3. gt911_isr_wrapper clears GPIO interrupt status (write 1 to D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT)

**PASS** -- Lines 199-216 of `artinchip_touch.c`. The wrapper writes `(1 << pin)` to `D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT(group)` at line 206 before calling the original ISR. The `D13X_GPIO_IRQ_STAT` macro is defined at line 55 as write-1-to-clear per the D13x manual.

### 4. gt911_irq_attach uses gt911_isr_wrapper

**PASS** -- Line 252 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
```c
irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_GPIO, gt911_isr_wrapper, arg);
```
The wrapper is used instead of the raw ISR, and it chains to `g_gt911_isr` (the gt9xx driver's `gt9xx_isr_handler`) at line 212.

### 5. PA2 configured: PIN_FUN=1, input, falling edge

**PASS** -- Lines 234-248 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
- **PIN_FUN=1 (GPIO generic function):** Lines 234-237 write `GPIO_FUN_GEN` (=1, line 77) to the PIN_FUN field.
- **Input mode:** Line 241 calls `gpio_set_input(GT911_INT_PIN)`.
- **Falling edge:** Lines 245-248 write `GPIO_IRQ_FALLING` (=0, line 70) to the IRQ_MODE field at bit shift 12.

### 6. gt911_config_table: verify checksum at 0x80FF (184 bytes config)

**PASS** -- Lines 336-354 of `artinchip_touch.c`. The config table contains exactly 184 data bytes (the last 2 bytes `0x79, 0x01` at line 353 are the checksum and update flag). The `GT911_CONFIG_SIZE` is defined as 184 at line 401, and `GT911_CHECKSUM_REG` is `0x80FF` at line 402. The config starts at register `0x8047` (lines 412-413).

### 7. gt911_write_config: checksum computed over 184 bytes only

**PASS** -- Lines 421-426 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
```c
for (i = 0; i < GT911_CONFIG_SIZE; i++)
  {
    checksum += gt911_config_table[i];
  }
checksum = (~checksum) + 1;
```
The loop runs exactly `GT911_CONFIG_SIZE` (184) iterations, summing only the first 184 bytes of `gt911_config_table`. The checksum is the two's complement (invert + 1) placed at offset `buf[2 + 184]` (line 427), which maps to register `0x80FF`.

### 8. GTP_POINT1 address 0x814F

**PASS** -- Line 72 of `gt9xx.c`:
```c
#define GTP_POINT1         0x814f  /* Touch Point 1 (Track ID) */
```
Used at line 427 to read touch point data.

### 9. Input device registered at /dev/input0

**PASS** -- Line 507 of `artinchip_touch.c`:
```c
ret = gt9xx_register("/dev/input0", i2c, GT911_I2C_ADDR, &g_gt911_board);
```
The `gt9xx_register` function in `gt9xx.c` passes `devpath` to `register_driver()` at line 941, confirming the device path is `/dev/input0`.

### 10. gt9xx_register called correctly

**PASS** -- Line 507 of `artinchip_touch.c` calls `gt9xx_register` with four arguments:
1. `"/dev/input0"` -- device path (matches parameter name `devpath` at gt9xx.c line 912)
2. `i2c` -- I2C bus handle obtained from `d13x_i2c_get_bus(GT911_I2C_BUS)` (line 489)
3. `GT911_I2C_ADDR` -- I2C address 0x5D (matches `uint8_t i2c_devaddr` at gt9xx.c line 914)
4. `&g_gt911_board` -- board callback struct (matches `const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config` at gt9xx.c line 915)

The `gt9xx_register` function (gt9xx.c lines 912-962) correctly:
- Allocates device structure (line 925)
- Sets addr, i2c, board fields (lines 934-936)
- Registers the driver at the device path (line 941)
- Attaches the interrupt handler via `board->irq_attach` (line 953) -- which invokes `gt911_irq_attach` using `gt9xx_isr_handler` as the ISR
- Disables interrupts initially (line 958)

107: /* XSPI_CTL 位域 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
108: 
109: #define CTL_XSPI_EN         (1 << 0)
110: #define CTL_XIP_EN          (1 << 2)
111: #define CTL_AXI_BURST       (1 << 3)
112: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT 4
113: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_MASK  (0x3 << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT)
114: #define CTL_PARALLEL_MODE   (1 << 6)
115: #define CTL_TIMEOUT_EN      (1 << 7)
116: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_EN     (1 << 12)
117: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL    (1 << 13)
118: 
119: /* XSPI 模式 */
120: 
121: #define XSPI_MODE_XCCELA    0
122: #define XSPI_MODE_HYPERBUS  1
123: #define XSPI_MODE_OPI       2
124: #define XSPI_MODE_SPI       3
125: 
126: /* XSPI_STAS 位域 */
127: 
128: #define STAS_BUSY            (1 << 0)
129: 
130: /* XSPI_FCR 位域 */
131: 
132: #define FCR_RF_RST           (1 << 15)
133: #define FCR_TF_RST           (1 << 31)
134: 
135: /* LUT 指令 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
136: 
137: #define LUT_STOP             0x0
138: #define LUT_CMD              0x1
139: #define LUT_CMD_EX           0x2
140: #define LUT_ADDR             0x3
141: #define LUT_WRITE            0x4
142: #define LUT_READ             0x5
143: #define LUT_CMD_DDR          0x11
144: #define LUT_ADDR_DDR         0x13
145: #define LUT_WRITE_DDR        0x14
146: #define LUT_READ_DDR         0x15
147: #define LUT_DUMMY            0x10
148: 
149: /* LUT IO 模式 */
150: 
151: #define LUT_IO_1             0x0
152: #define LUT_IO_2             0x1
153: #define LUT_IO_4             0x2
154: #define LUT_IO_8             0x3
155: 
156: /* LUT 锁定 */
157: 
158: #define LUT_LOCK             0x1
159: #define LUT_UNLOCK           0x2
160: 
161: /* LUT 条目编码宏 */
162: 
163: #define LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l) \
164:   (((ins_h) << 26) | ((io_h) << 24) | ((op_h) << 16) | \
165:    ((ins_l) << 10) | ((io_l) << 8) | (op_l))
166: 
167: /* BSS 段符号 */
168: 
169: extern uint32_t _sbss[];
170: extern uint32_t _ebss[];
171: extern uint32_t _sdata[];
172: extern uint32_t _edata[];
173: extern uint32_t _eronly[];

175: /****************************************************************************
176:  * Private Functions
177:  ****************************************************************************/
178: 
179: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
180: {
181:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
182: }
183: 
184: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
185: {
186:   uint32_t reg;
187: 
188:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
189: 
190:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
191:   reg |= (1 << 1);
192:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
193: 
194:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
197:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
198:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
199: 
200:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
201: 
202:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
203:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
204:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
205:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
206: 
207:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
208: 
209:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
210:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
211:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
212:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
213:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
214:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
215: 
216:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
217: 
218:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
219: 
220:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
221: 
222:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
223: 
224:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
225: 
226:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
227: 
228:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 (MOD_RSTN bit13 + MOD_BUS_EN bit12 + MOD_CLK_EN bit8) */
229: 
230:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
231:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
232:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
233: 
234:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
235: 
236:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
237:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
238: }

240: /****************************************************************************
241:  * UART0 引脚配置 (PA0=UART0_TX, PA1=UART0_RX)
242:  * 来源: D13x ic/pinmux/index.html + luban-lite target/d13x/demo88-nor/pinmux.c
243:  ****************************************************************************/
244: 
245: static void d13x_uart_pinmux_init(void)
246: {
247:   uint32_t val;
248: 
249:   /* PA.0 (UART0_TX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 0*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700080 */
250: 
251:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
252:                  0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
253:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
254:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
255:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
256:            0 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
257: 
258:   /* PA.1 (UART0_RX): GPIO_BASE + 0*0x100 + 1*0x4 + 0x80 = 0x18700084 */
259: 
260:   val = getreg32(D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
261:                  1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
262:   val &= ~(GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT);
263:   val |= (UART0_PIN_FUN & GPIO_PIN_FUN_MASK) << GPIO_PIN_FUN_SHIFT;
264:   putreg32(val, D13X_GPIO_BASE + 0 * GPIO_GROUP_FACTOR +
265:            1 * GPIO_PIN_FACTOR + GPIO_PIN_CFG_REG);
266: }
267: 
268: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
269: {
270:   uint32_t divisor;
271: 
272:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
273:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
274:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
275:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
276:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
277:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
278:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
279:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
280:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
281: }
282: 
283: /****************************************************************************
284:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
285:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
286:  ****************************************************************************/
287: 
288: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
289: {
290:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
291:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
292:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
293:   return val;
294: }
295: 
296: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
297: {
298:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
299:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
300: 
301:   switch (mark_id)
302:     {
303:       case 0x00: return 0;
304:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
305:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
306:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
307:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
308:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
309:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
310:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
311:     }
312: }
313: 
314: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
315:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
316:  */
317: 
318: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
319:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
320:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
321: {
322:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
323:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
324: }
325: 
326: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
327: {
328:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
329: }
330: 
331: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
332: {
333:   xspi_wait_idle();
334:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
335:   xspi_wait_idle();
336: }
337: 
338: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
339: 
340: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
341: {
342:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
343:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
344:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
345:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
346:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349: 
350:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
351: 
352:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
353: 
354:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
355: 
356:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
357: 
358:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
359: 
360:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
361: }
362: 
363: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
364: {
365:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
366:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
367:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
368:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
369:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
370:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
371:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
372: 
373:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
374:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
375: 
376:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
377: }
378: 
379: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
380: {
381:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
382: 
383:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
384:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
385:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
386: }
387: 
388: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
389: {
390:   uint8_t mr4;
391: 
392:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
393: 
394:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
395: 
396:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
397: 
398:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
399: 
400:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
401: 
402:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
403: }
404: 
405: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
406: {
407:   uint32_t ctl;
408: 
409:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
410:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
411:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
412:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
413:    */
414: 
415:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
416: 
417:   xspi_wait_idle();
418:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
419:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
420:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
421: }
422: 
423: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
424: {
425:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
426:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
427: 
428:   if (psram_size == 0)
429:     return 0;
430: 
431:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
432:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
433: 
434:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
435:     return 0;
436:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
437:     return 0;
438: 
439:   psram[0] = 0;
440:   psram[1] = 0;
441:   return psram_size;
442: }
443: 
444: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
445: {
446:   uint32_t reg;
447: 
448:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
449: 
450:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
451:     return;
452: 
453:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
454: 
455:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
456:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
457:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
458: 
459:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
460: 
461:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
462: 
463:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
464: 
465:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
466: 
467:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
468: 
469:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
470: 
471:   xspi_wait_idle();
472:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
473: 
474:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
475: 
476:   xspi_wait_idle();
477:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
478:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
479:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
480: 
481:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
482: 
483:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
484:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
485:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
486: 
487:   /* Boundary = 1K */
488: 
489:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
490:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
491:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
492: 
493:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
494: 
495:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
496:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
497:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
498:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
499:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
500:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
501:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
502:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
503: 
504:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
505: 
506:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
507: 
508:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
509:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
510:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
511: 
512:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
513: 
514:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
515:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
516:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
517: 
518:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
519: 
520:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
521:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
522:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
523:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
524:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
525:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
526: 
527:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
528: 
529:   xspi_wait_idle();
530:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
531:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
532:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
533: 
534:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
535: 
536:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
537: 
538:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
539: 
540:   d13x_psram_device_init();
541: 
542:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
543: 
544:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
545: 
546:   /* 8. 验证 */
547: 
548:   d13x_psram_verify();
549: }

## Burning (烧录)

### Prerequisites
- NuttX compiled successfully (`nuttx` ELF + `nuttx.bin`)
- AiBurn installed (`~/.wine/drive_c/ArtInChip/AiBurn/AiBurn.exe`)

### Enter Burning Mode
| Method | Operation |
|--------|-----------|
| Empty chip | Auto-enter on power on |
| BOOT button | Hold BOOT + Insert Type-C |
| U-Boot console | Press Ctrl+C, enter `aicupg usb 0` |
| Linux console | Enter `aicupg` |
| ADB | AiBurn auto-detect |

### Check Device
```bash
lsusb | grep -i artinchip
# Should show: Bus 001 Device 008: ID 33c3:6677 Artinchip Artinchip Device
```

### Launch AiBurn
```bash
wine ~/.wine/drive_c/ArtInChip/AiBurn/AiBurn.exe
```

### Burning Steps
1. Select "烧写镜像" tab
2. Click folder icon, select `.img` file
3. Confirm connection is USB
4. Click "开始" to burn
5. Wait for completion, board auto-reboots

### Image Format
```
Offset 0x00: "AIC.FW" (6 bytes magic)
Offset 0x06: Reserved (2 bytes)
Offset 0x08: "d13x" (platform name)
```
